newsitem.title: USA: Cleveland launches seat sales for football stadium.
newsitem.headline: Cleveland launches seat sales for football stadium.

text.p: Cleveland launched a luxury suite sales program Tuesday for the city's planned $220 million football stadium.
The 108 stadium suites will carry a pricetag of $60,000 to $125,000 per year, according to a news release from the city.
At least $9.4 million of seats leases must be sold by Jan 31, 1997, under an agreement with the National Football League which has committed to contributing up to $48 million to the stadium project.
The rest of the stadium financing will come from the issuance of debt by Cleveland, Ohio capital budget grants and contributions from other city agencies.

Last Tuesday, Cleveland sold $15 million of nontax revenue bond anticipation notes to help fund the demolition of Municipal Stadium, the former home of the Cleveland Browns football team, to make way for the new stadium.
Cleveland has been promised a new franchise by the NFL to replace the team that owner Art Modell moved to Baltimore earlier this year to play under the name Ravens.
